stories.headline: Paraguay swears in Pedro Alliana as president
stories.summary: Paraguay's Senate removed President Santiago Peña from office after the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to reach their savings. Vice President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president on 6 November. Ueno had been licensed as a bank only in 2023.

stories.headline: Belgium's king refuses his prime minister's resignation
stories.summary: Bart De Wever offered to resign as prime minister of Belgium as negotiations over the country's budget stalled. King Philippe refused the resignation and told him to continue with the budget talks. De Wever has held the office since February 2025.

stories.headline: Mexico passes a law on digital payments
stories.summary: Mexico has approved a law called the Digital Economy Act for Digital and Electronic Payments. It allows the government to designate sectors in which digital payments are the only accepted means of payment.

stories.headline: Dinosaur blood survives in 115-million-year-old bones
stories.summary: An international team led by Curtin University has found fossilised red blood cells, and chemical evidence of blood molecules, in the bones of a meat-eating dinosaur called Aratasaurus museunacionali. The remains are about 115 million years old. The analysis found heme molecules, which are components of the protein that lets red blood cells carry oxygen.

explanations: Alliana was Paraguay's vice president, and was sworn in as president on 6 November 2026. He had earlier been a national deputy and president of the Chamber of Deputies.
King Philippe refused the resignation and told Bart De Wever to continue with budget negotiations. De Wever has served as prime minister of Belgium since February 2025.

Hércules Pedro Lorenzo Alliana Rodríguez (born 19 February 1974) is a Paraguayan politician who serves as the President of the Republic of Paraguay since 6 November 2026. A former National Deputy of Paraguay from 2013 to 2023, he previously served as president of the Chamber of Deputies.
Bart Albert Liliane De Wever (born 21 December 1970) is a Belgian politician who has served as the Prime Minister of Belgium since February 2025.
Mexico approves the Digital Economy Act for Digital and Electronic Payments, which allows it to designate sectors in which digital payments are the only accepted means of payment.

An international team led by Curtin University found fossilized red blood cells and chemical evidence of blood molecules in the remains of Aratasaurus museunacionali, a meat-eating theropod dinosaur discovered in northeastern Brazil.
Scientists have discovered chemically confirmed traces of ancient blood inside 115-million-year-old dinosaur bones, challenging assumptions about how long biological molecules can survive.
Chemical analysis revealed preserved heme molecules, which are components of hemoglobin, the protein that allows red blood cells to transport oxygen.
